viewing_check: Estimate $50-100, current bid $30 (buyers premium 22%). Console is untested: ask for or check power, disc read and controller ports. Game discs unverified; the 'pre-played' unbranded case and 8MB cards add little. Ten of 19 games are low value; Final Fight Streetwise and Ace Combat Squadron Leader are the best. Sold prices are from Nov 2026 back to 2024, flat to rising for working PS2 slim consoles (retro demand).
searches_tried: Google PAL PS2 game price guide; Terapeak AU: ps2 console games bundle; ps2 slim console controllers games (mostly adapters/accessories); playstation 2 slim bundle (63 sales of one tested bundle at ~$190).
flip_reason: Tested PS2 slim bundles with cables sell about $170-190 (63 and 7 sales at the same sellers); this lot has the console, 3 controllers, ~20 games and cards but is untested, cables unclear, and bid is $30 (about $37 with premium). Resale of console plus games individually could clear $100 profit if it works, but the sold comps are tested complete bundles and the matched sellers are not like-for-like. Postage of a console bundle is moderate.
